# Sample AI Directive

## 1 Introduction

This sample directive sets out requirements for the responsible use of artificial intelligence by sample organizations.

## 2 Principles

AI use must be transparent, accountable and secure. People affected by an AI-supported decision should be able to get a meaningful explanation.

## 3 Application and scope

### 3.1 In scope

The directive applies to all sample ministries that use AI systems, whether developed in-house or procured.

### 3.2 Out of scope

Research prototypes that never reach production are out of scope.

## 4 Risk management

Organizations must assess the risk of each AI use case before deployment and keep the assessment current. High-risk use cases require human oversight of decisions, logging of system actions, and an audit trail that can be reviewed independently.
